part2.question: Describe an activity you do regularly that you think is a waste of time

segments.v: I want to talk about using TikTok before I sleep. I do it almost every night after I finish my homework, at about 11 pm. I want to relax a little but I usually watch videos for more than one hour. I do it because it is a habit and it is relaxing. I also want to know the new trends like my friends. I think it is a waste of time because I don't remember the videos after I watch them. I also sleep late and I feel tired the next day. Sometimes I feel bad when I see other people's perfect lives. Now I try to leave my phone in the living room at night. It is difficult but I feel better when I do it.

fluency.band6: Honest reasons, but short, similar sentences.
fluency.band9: What and when → a question to organise reasons (Why do I do it?) → three reasons it's a waste (First, Second, Third) with a simile → how the speaker is fighting back.

lexical.band6: relax, habit, trends, tired, feel bad.

grammar.band9: Present perfect (I've started fighting back), “Partly it's… Partly it's that…”, “leave + object + feeling + adjective”, and a non-defining relative on a whole clause (which proves to me…).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 gives honest reasons but in short, similar sentences. Band 9 uses a question to organise the talk, a vivid simile (crisps), three signposted reasons, and an honest ending about fighting the habit.
